newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends solidly higher but rally lags big caps.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends solidly higher but rally lags big caps.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks bounded higher Monday but their rally fell short of the advance posted by large-cap stocks.

The Nasdaq Composite rose 9.31 points or 0.82 percent to close unofficially at 1148.70. The Dow industrials gained about 74 points, or 1.31 percent, to 5734 and the S&P 500 rose eight points, or 1.23 percent, to 664.
Traders said Nasdaq's gains, while welcome, did not yet appear to reflect a strong investor re-entry to the smaller-cap arena because volume remained relatively light.
"It seems like people are putting more money into the market, but we're still not seeing real high volumes kick in yet," said Brett Discher, vice president at Dain Bosworth.

Discher said Internet-related stocks were particularly strong among Nasdaq stocks. The American Stock Exchange's Internet index, most of which is comprised of Nasdaq-listed stocks, rose 3.42 points, or 1.54 percent, to 225.15. Modem maker U.S. Robotics Inc rose 4-3/8 to 53-1/8.
Big B Inc was Nasdaq's most active stock, jumping 3-1/4 to 15-7/8 after Revco D.S. Inc announced a $15-per-share tender offer for the company.
